name: Digispice Technologies Ltd
title: Digispice Technologies Ltd-$ - 517214 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Digispice (Spice Money AEPS/BC agent network) grew GTV 10.5% to INR127.9k cr with gross margin up 13% to INR201cr on higher-margin credit and insurance, but Q4 gross margin fell to INR48.6cr and growth is subsidy-cycle driven.

triggers.label: UPI Cash Point run rate ~INR100cr/month
triggers.quote: we are already at a run rate of almost INR 100 crores GTV for a month, and we are holding a market share of close to 30% to 35%
triggers.highlight: run rate of almost INR 100 crores GTV for a month

triggers.label: CMS collections under pricing pressure
triggers.quote: the CMS business in this cash collections pie has been under a high competitive pricing pressure
triggers.highlight: under a high competitive pricing pressure

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin down INR3cr QoQ
triggers.quote: quarter 4, we have a gross margin of INR48.6 crores, which is INR3 crores down from the previous quarter

guidance.value: at least 20% YoY for coming 2-3 years
guidance.quote: we should be clocking 20% growth year-on-year in the coming 2, 3 years, what we envisage

guidance.value: EBITDA positive in the credit engine this quarter
guidance.quote: we are hopeful that considering that in this quarter, we will be kind of achieving the EBITDA positive in the credit engine

guidance.metric: UPI Cash Point share of AEPS
guidance.quote: this product with our presence will have almost in next 1 to 2 years, there will be a 50% of what we are doing in AEPS

red_flags.label: Subsidy-driven quarterly volatility
red_flags.quote: seasonality with respect to subsidy cycles

red_flags.label: Pricing pressure in CMS collections
red_flags.quote: under a high competitive pricing pressure

evasions.quote: there was some onetime adjustment in the previous quarters, which is kind of reflecting over here and in the quarter 4 also
